shortDescription: Fetch objects or a library from a remote IBM i node and store on local

options.name: backup
options.description: If delete the save file on remote IBM i or not. If set True, the save file on remote IBM i will not be deleted.

options.name: dest
options.description: A local directory to save the file into. For example, if the dest directory is /backup save file named /qsys.lib/objlib.lib/test1.file on host host.example.com, would be saved into /backup/host.example.com/qsys.lib/objlib.lib/test1.file. The host name is based on the inventory name. If dest='', dest will be current directory.

options.name: flat
options.description: Allows you to override the default behavior of appending hostname/path/to/file to the destination. This can be useful if working with a single host, or if retrieving files that are uniquely named per host. If using multiple hosts with the same filename, the file will be overwritten for each host.

options.name: force_save
options.description: If force to use savefile_name when savefile_name.file already exists on remote IBM i.

options.name: format
options.description: The save file's format. Only support C(*SAVF) by now.

options.name: is_lib
options.description: If it is a library needed to be fetched. If set True, the whole library will be fetched.

options.name: lib_name
options.description: The library contains the objects. If is_lib is C(True), lib_name means the library name.

options.name: object_names
options.description: The objects need to be fetched. One or more object names can be specified. Use space as separator. If object type is C(*FILE), then fetch it directly. Only one C(*FILE) object will fetch directly at one time.

options.name: object_types
options.description: The object types. One or more object types can be specified. Use space as separator.

options.name: savefile_name
options.description: The save file name can be specified. If not specified savefile_name, the save file name will be the first object_name.file. If is_lib is True, the save file name will be lib_name.file. For example, if fetch obja.pgm and objb.srvpgm in objlib library, the save file name will be obja. If the obja already exists in objlib, then rename the save file name to (obja+number), number range from 1 to 9(obja1, obja2...obja9).

options.name: target_release
options.description: The release of the operating system on which you intend to restore and use the SAVF.

options.name: validate_checksum
options.description: Verify that the source and destination checksums match after the files are fetched.
